The '''GX1 short hauler''', also known as the '''GX1 hauler''', '''GX1 diplomatic ship''', '''Lantillian short hauler''', '''Lantillian Hauler''', or '''Lantillian shuttle''', was a [[shuttle]] model manufactured by [[Lantillian ShipWrights]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic]] used several top-of-the-line GX1 short haulers, including the [[Phoenix (GX1 short hauler)|''Phoenix'']] and the ''[[Valorous]]'', as [[diplomat]]ic vessels. During the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]], GX1 shuttles were used as [[starbus]]es to ferry commuters from one location to another. Although the diplomatic variant was equipped with [[turret]]-mounted double [[laser cannon]]s, the civilian starbus variant had no weapons.

==Description==
[[File:GX1_top_view-SWE.png|thumb|left|150px|Top view of the ''Phoenix'']]
Measuring 37.28 [[meter]]s long, the GX1 short hauler was a model of shuttle<ref name="Databank Phoenix" /> designed for long, extended missions and tours of constituencies. As such, it was equipped<ref name="SWE Phoenix" /> with a Class 2 [[hyperdrive]].<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles" /> One of its variants, which was used during [[diplomat]]ic missions, was fitted with a [[turret]]-mounted double [[laser cannon]].<ref name="SWE Phoenix" /> It also had a pilotable secondary pod that detached from the primary hull and was equipped with its own compact hyperdrive, allowing delegates to escape the most uncomfortable situations.<ref name="Databank Phoenix" /> A civilian variant, which was used as a [[starbus]] for interplanetary travel, was devoid of armament<ref name="Blood Sisters">{{Rebels|Blood Sisters}}</ref> and [[pilot]]ed by an [[RX-series pilot droid|RX-Series pilot droid]].<ref name="GX1 Short Hauler" /> GX1 starbuses were also equipped with a pair of [[docking tube]]s that extended from either side of the ship like an accordion and replaced the detachable pod with a cargo bay door.<ref name="Blood Sisters" />

==History==
[[File:Starbus.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sabine's hijacked GX1 short hauler docking with the ''Shadow Caster'']]
Manufactured by [[Lantillian ShipWrights]],<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles" /> GX1 short haulers existed as far back as the [[time]] of [[Clone Wars]], which pitted the [[Galactic Republic]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During that conflict, the Republic utilized the [[Phoenix (GX1 short hauler)|''Phoenix'']], a [[Color|red]]-hulled top-of-the-line GX1, as a diplomatic vessel. It was notably used to bring Republic envoys to the neutral [[planet]] of [[Mandalore]], where talks with the Confederacy would take place.<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> Later in the Clone Wars,<ref name="An Old Friend">{{TCW|An Old Friend}}</ref> a GX1 known as the ''[[Valorous]]''<ref name="An Old Friend Episode Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/an-old-friend-episode-gallery|text="An Old Friend" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}}</ref> transported [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], who was accompanied by her [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaiden]] [[Teckla Minnau]] and [[Nix Card]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], to the planet [[Scipio]], where she was to secure a loan from the Banking Clan on the Republic's behalf.<ref name="An Old Friend" />

[[File:Starbus-SWOR.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Valorous'' being pursued by TIE fighters.]]
After the conclusion of the Clone Wars when the Republic transitioned into the [[Galactic Empire]], the GX1 short haulers were utilized as civilian transports and often seen throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles" /> During the ensuing [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]], a number of weaponless GX1s were used as interplanetary starbuses. In the [[Garel City Spaceport|spaceport]] of [[Garel City]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Garel]], there were a number of such starbuses. [[Garel Shuttle 63725|One]] of them was hijacked by the [[Spectres|freedom fighter]] [[Sabine Wren]], who was supposed to deliver the [[power droid]] [[EG-86]] to [[Havoc Outpost]].<ref name="Blood Sisters" />

A GX1 short hauler was taking off next to an Imperial [[Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|''Gozanti-''class Assault Carrier]] from the [[Coruscant Eastern Spaceport]] in [[3 BBY]] when [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] left the planet for [[Ghorman]].<ref name="Episode">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}</ref> 

Eventually, the Empire was [[Battle of Endor|defeated]] at [[Endor]]. Shortly thereafter, an armed GX1 shuttle was used to transport [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and [[Shara Bey]], on behalf of the fledgling [[New Republic]], to the planet [[Naboo]] for negotiations.<ref name="Part II" />

At least one short hauler responded to [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian's]] call to action against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] and fought with the [[Citizens' Fleet]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The GX1 short hauler first appeared in ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'', a [[1988]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] book written by [[Paul Murphy]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref> Its design was derived from an early concept of what would become the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], drawn by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] in [[1981]].<ref name="A Friend in Need Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/a-friend-in-need-trivia-gallery|text="A Friend in Need" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}}</ref>

It became [[canon]] after its inclusion in "[[A Friend in Need]]," the fourteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]].<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> The name "GX1 short hauler," however, was only introduced in canon after the ship was given an official [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]], following the release of "[[Blood Sisters]]," the sixth episode of the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' animated television series' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]].<ref name="GX1 Short Hauler" />
